randomness.per_row_seed: first 8 bytes as unsigned little-endian integer of SHA256(UTF8('C1-02/v1|'+data_seed+'|'+root_sample_id+'|'+pair_mode+'|'+stream_name))

local.reject: any joint outside inclusive limits or exact q_current == q_target

wide.start: independent PCG64 uniform(lower,upper) six-vector using per-row wide stream; no target q in draw or acceptance
wide.target: verified F0-04 root q and its Pinocchio FK pose; no teacher-success filtering

teacher.solver: src/neurokinematics/solvers/dls.py DLS with exact frozen experiments/F0-05/solver-config.json
teacher.restart_sampling: per-row PCG64 uniform(lower,upper); four calls total including q_current
teacher.watchdog: 30 minute pilot job wall cap; overrun aborts job rather than changing individual candidate eligibility
teacher.validation: finite shape-6, inclusive joint limits, independently recomputed Pinocchio FK Profile B <=0.001 m and <=0.5 degree; solver status alone insufficient
teacher.selection_distance: sqrt(sum(((q_candidate-q_current)/(upper-lower))**2)); raw bounded-joint distance without circular wrapping
teacher.selection_tie_break: exact float64 distance equality: lower candidate_start ordinal; then lexicographically smaller canonical little-endian q bytes
teacher.failure: no valid candidate => null q_target label, teacher_status=FAILED, explicit failure_class; retain target and start
teacher.train_missing_label: mask supervised joint label and count by failure_class; preserve row for geometry-only audit; no replacement target
teacher.validation_test_missing_label: retain every row in evaluation inventory; do not filter by teacher result

pilot.selection: first 10 root_sample_id lexical order per subset/split, fixed before teacher outcomes
pilot.gate: validate all input and candidate contracts, resource cap, missing-label and branch-distribution report; technical failure or cap overrun stops full generation, no success-rate threshold invented

kinematics.quaternion_canonicalization: F0-04 normalize; w>0 or exact w=0 first nonzero xyz positive
kinematics.target_fk: PinocchioFK plus IndependentFK cross-check at F0-04 1e-9 m and 1e-9 rotation Frobenius

normalization.fit: C1-02 train rows only after pair generation and label masking; exclude null labels from label statistics
normalization.q_current: per-joint lower/upper limit affine scaling; no circular wrapping
normalization.q_target_label: per-joint lower/upper limit affine scaling, label only
normalization.quaternion: canonical unit wxyz, no per-component refit

output.shard_format: deterministic uncompressed NPZ typed arrays, fixed ZIP member order/timestamps, no pickle
output.canonical_content_hash: F0-04 canonical_array_hash field-name/dtype/shape/little-endian C-order bytes in schema order; manifest hashes ordered shard content digests
output.storage: large shards ignored by Git; schema/config/manifest/audits/hashes in experiments/C1-02

evaluation_isolation.policy: F0-05/C1-01 12000 queries are independent evaluation only; compare root group, source family, exact q_target/q_current and pose overlap; never select or drop by teacher success
